dedupe_keys.name: 統計年鑑 7 電気 カス及ひ上下水道 electricity and power and sewerage and wastewater series on tokyo open data catalog

description: 統計年鑑 7 電気、ガス及び上下水道 [electricity and power and sewerage and wastewater] (series on Tokyo Open Data Catalog) is a series of datasets listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都総務局. 【東京都総務局】. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都総務局. It offers 18 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
